maria (docs): Heads-up — merged #4213 and CI docusaurus build is failing on linkcheck, looks like a duplicate fragment id error for 'getting-started'. anyone seen this before? sam (eng): ugh, saw something similar last month. can you paste the CI output? :eyes: maria (docs): sure — excerpt from the linkcheck step: ``` LinkCheckError: Duplicate fragment 'getting-started' found in: - /docs/intro/getting-started - /docs/guides/getting-started Please disambiguate fragments or use explicit ids. ``` jun (devex): Docusaurus uses a slugger for headings so identical headings across pages can collide in the global fragment map for linkcheck. two quick fixes: add explicit ids in the MDX page or change the link to point at the full path (include the page path) instead of the fragment-only link. oliver (infra): quick option: add a small inline anchor on one of the pages like `
` above the header and update the internal link to `#/docs/guides/getting-started#getting-started-guides`. ugly but fast for a hotfix. maria (docs): thanks — i can push a tiny PR to add the explicit anchor on the guides page and update the backrefs. will that avoid changing permalinks? sam (eng): yes, that keeps permalinks stable. prefer using a more readable id though (e.g. `getting-started-guides`) so it's clear. docbot: deploy-bot: re-run requested by maria (docs) — build queued. :repeat: jun (devex): longer term we should add a linkcheck rule to fail on duplicate fragments during pre-merge, plus a linter that flags same heading text in multiple pages that are meant to be link targets. i can sketch a CI job for that (node script that runs @docusaurus/linkcheck and greps for duplicate ids). maria (docs): that'd be great. short-term PR: i will add the inline anchor + update a couple of links in the affected PRs, and include a tiny note in the PR description explaining the reason. assigning to sam to review for infra/perm stability. sam (eng): ack — will review shortly. if CI looks green after the hotfix i'll merge and then we can follow up with the CI lint work. maria (docs): thanks all — placing the PR link here once it's open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/4278. keeping this thread for follow-up on adding the duplicate-anchor check. :thumbsup: oliver (infra): FYI i can add an ephemeral job to re-run the docs build in the CI cluster if the first retry flakes. saved us earlier. maria (docs): perfect — i'll wait for sam's review and then merge the hotfix. will open a separate ticket for the CI/lint work and ping devex. sam (eng): thanks — feel free to add me to the ticket. maria (docs): done, ticket created: https://linear.app/rw/issue/INF-1123-duplicate-doc-fragments. I'll close thread after merge.
